string_literals: Fingerprint is not set up on your device. Go to 'Settings > Security' to add your fingerprint.
Hint message advising the user how to scan their fingerprint. It is used on Android side. Maximum 60 characters.
Local authentication does not support non-Android/iOS operating systems.
Message advising the user to go to the settings and configure Touch ID on their device. It shows in a dialog on iOS side.
Message advising the user to go to the settings and configure fingerprint on their device. It shows in a dialog on Android side.
Message advising the user to re-enable Touch ID on their device. It shows in a dialog on iOS side.
Message showed as a title in a dialog which indicates the user fingerprint is not set up yet on their device. It is used on Android side. Maximum 60 characters.
Message showed as a title in a dialog which indicates the user that they need to scan fingerprint to continue. It is used on Android side. Maximum 60 characters.
Message showed on a button that the user can click to go to settings pages from the current dialog. It is used on both Android and iOS side. Maximum 30 characters.
Message showed on a button that the user can click to leave the current dialog. It is used on Andorid side. Maxium 30 characters.
Message showed on a button that the user can click to leave the current dialog. It is used on iOS side. Maximum 30 characters.
Message to let the user know that authentication was failed. It is used on Android side. Maximum 60 characters.
Message to let the user know that authentication was successful. It is used on Android side. Maximum 60 characters.
Touch ID is disabled. Please lock and unlock your screen to enable it.
Touch ID is not set up on your device. Go to 'Settings > Touch ID & Passcode' to add your fingerprint.
